title: error inside a called function has no call stack
notes: Correct line inside the function body, but nothing says which call site reached it. With recursion or a shared helper this is the whole question. Location 1 -> 2 (phase-3 item 7): `  in defs.greet.return` now names the function the body belongs to, which is half of that question -- *which* function, though still not which call. The call chain is a Location 3 criterion.
